note: Reference spend for cross-implementation testing. Produced by the same construction path as the transaction testnet-10 accepted. Compare unsignedSignatureScriptHex and sighashHex; the signature itself is nondeterministic and is recorded for reference only.

key._comment: Fixed and public. NEVER FUND THIS. Derived from blake2b-256("warda-golden-vector-v1") so any implementation can regenerate the whole vector.

recipients._comment: Unsorted as given; the tree sorts canonically before hashing.

successor._comment: A different address: the state is part of what the address commits to, so spending MOVES the grant.

input._comment: A version-1 input commits to a COMPUTE BUDGET, not a sigop count; the sigop field does not exist on it.
